Description
Welcome home to The Grafton, situated in the vibrant Yaletown area. This southeast-facing open-concept condo features laminate and tile flooring throughout and floor-to-ceiling windows that allow abundant natural light and fresh air to flow throughout the space. The living area features a cozy fireplace, while the spacious patio offers a lovely spot to unwind. The kitchen comes equipped with high-end appliances and marble countertops. Residents of The Grafton enjoy access to amenities including a rooftop garden and green space, a bike room, and a library. Nestled in the heart of Yaletown and Downtown, you’re steps from beautiful parks, the seawall, and some of Vancouver's most popular cafes and restaurants.
